learning_outcomes.text: Create functional, manufacturing, verification, and assembly drawings.
Propose simple design solutions for mechanical problems (assembly, functional, strength, etc.).
Design and simulate mechanisms with advanced design software.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to mechanism design: element joining, sealing, motion transmission, rotation transformation, etc.
Relationship of roughness with the manufacturing process
Design criteria for sheet metal parts

Mechanical systems: graphic representation, standardization, design criteria, selection of elements from catalogs, applications to specific design problems (support and fastening elements, couplings, cooling, motion transmission, housings, etc.)
Design of parts and mechanisms in 3D

assessment_methods.method: Experimental work tests and reports: Preliminary project submission

assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 5/10 is required for the long answer test and the computer test. A minimum grade of 4/10 is required for the preliminary project presentation to be included in the final grade calculation. If any of these minimums are not met, the maximum final grade for the course will be 4.5/10 (Fail). The long answer test, improved preliminary project, and computer test are recoverable.
